title: Microsoft Teams: Breakout rooms up to 1,000 Attendees in Teams meetings
description: Organizers can now use breakout rooms in Teams meetings with up to 1,000 attendees, enabling more interactive sessions, smaller group discussions, and improved audience engagement without compromising scale or performance.
